title: A Hailstone 8 Inches Wide and 2 Pounds Heavy Fell From the Sky

scenes.text: In 2010, a hailstone eight inches wide fell on South Dakota.
It weighed almost two pounds and punched straight through a wooden deck.
The finder put it in his freezer. The power went out, and it melted three inches before anyone measured it.
To hold ice that heavy in the air, the storm's updraft was blowing upward at 160 to 180 miles an hour.
It's still the widest and heaviest hailstone ever recorded in the United States.
Eight inches when measured. Maybe eleven when it landed.

description:
On July 23, 2010, a hailstone 8 inches across and weighing 1.94 pounds fell in Vivian, South Dakota, the largest and heaviest ever recorded in the United States.
It crashed through a deck and left a divot in the ground; the finder said it was about 3 inches wider before a power outage partly melted it in his freezer. The storm's updraft was estimated at 160 to 180 miles an hour.
What is the biggest hail you have ever seen?
first_comment: The previous record holder was 7 inches wide and fell in Nebraska in 2003. Would you run outside to grab a record hailstone or stay under the roof?
